definitions.explanation: A Japanese martial art developed from jujitsu, focusing on throws and grappling. Now practiced worldwide and an Olympic sport.

examples.japanese: {柔道|じゅうどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}っています→習う：00479_narau⟧。
{柔道|じゅうどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ました→見る：00283_miru⟧。
{柔道|じゅうどう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧⟦{武道|ぶどう}→武道：09640_budou⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Judo is a martial art born in Japan.

notes:
{柔道|じゅうどう} literally means 'the gentle way' ({柔|じゅう} = soft/gentle, {道|どう} = way).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {柔道|じゅうどう}をする/やる: to do judo
- {柔道|じゅうどう}を{習|なら}う: to learn judo
- {柔道着|じゅうどうぎ}: judo uniform
- {柔道|じゅうどう}{選手|せんしゅ}: judo athlete
- {黒帯|くろおび}: black belt

OTHER MARTIAL ARTS:
- {剣道|けんどう}: kendo (sword fighting)
- {空手|からて}: karate
- {合気道|あいきどう}: aikido
- {相撲|すもう}: sumo

Judo was founded by {嘉納|かのう}{治五郎|じごろう} in 1882 and became an Olympic sport in 1964.
